title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
body:
We obtain $$n$$ data points $$(n$$ is some large fixed integer) which have been generated from the true model
$$Y=f(x)+\epsilon$$
where $$\epsilon$$ is random noise with $$E[\epsilon]=0$$ and $$Var(\epsilon)=\sigma**{2}.$$
We fit linear models of varying complexity to our data, and plotted the bias, variance, and irreducible error below.
